procurement_policy_details: Purchased from Telangana State Handloom Weavers Cooperative Society Ltd. (TSCO), Hyderabad, based on requirements from all 33 districts. Indent placed in January/February; cloth received in June/July. Payment released on receipt of bills countersigned by the concerned DSCDO with stock-entry details. Annual process.

Purchased from Telangana State Trade Promotion Corporation Ltd. (TSTPC), Hyderabad, based on district requirements. Indent placed in January/February; books received in April/May. Payment released on countersigned bills with stock-entry details. Annual process.

Computers, printers, scanners, photocopiers and accessories are purchased from Telangana State Technology Services (TSTS), Hyderabad, as required for the State office and for district/subordinate offices; payment released on countersigned bills with stock-entry details.

Stationery, furniture and miscellaneous items for the State office are purchased via a minimum of 3 sealed quotations from wholesale dealers (for requirements below Rs. 1 lakh), with the lowest quote awarded the order on credit; payment made via account transfer from the PAO. Orders may also be placed with Government agencies such as MARKFED, TSAGROS, HACA.

A Purchase Committee headed by the Joint Collector finalizes rates for material required by the district office, subordinate offices and hostels, via sealed tenders opened and negotiated for the best competitive rate and quality.

Trunk boxes, plates & glasses, buckets, sports material, cooking utensils, stationery, study material — ordered by the DSCDO and supplied by the approved tenderer; inspected by a Quality Control/Verification Committee before payment (bank transfer); material transported to subordinate offices/hostels by the Department.

Dal varieties, cooking oil, tamarind, chilli powder, millets, salt, etc. — ordered by the DSCDO based on a bi-monthly indent from hostels; the HWO accepts supplies matching the sample and arranges payment via bank transfer.
Vegetables, fruits, eggs, milk are purchased by the HWO locally at or below the wholesale market price of the day; payment via bank transfer.
